node.statement: Apply lem-hcb1-column-action to arbitrary U: its contract says ||(Ha^Q_{P,T})_n(A)U-A dot U|| measured in q_P is at most C_act*e||A||q_T(U). The preceding child bounds the second term by K||A||q_T(U). Hence ||(Ha^Q_{P,T})_n(A)U||_{q_P}<=(K+C_act*e)||A||q_T(U). Shrink e_0 to at most min(e_u,e_m,e_act,1), and enlarge K once to dominate K+C_act. Taking the supremum over nonzero U proves the claimed uniform Ha operator bound together with controls (i)-(iii). This use cites lem-hcb1-column-action by its exact registered name.
